newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel to publish natural gas distribution tender.
newsitem.headline: Israel to publish natural gas distribution tender.

text.p: Israel hopes to publish a tender within three months to award a company rights to set up a domestic natural gas distribution network, an official at the National Infrastructure Ministry said on Monday.

The ministry said in a statement on Monday that it had reached an agreement with the Treasury on the terms for natural gas distribution. The terms now go to the ministerial economic committee for approval, it said.
The ministry said a single private company would be chosen by tender "as soon as possible" to transport and distribute the gas. It said other details of the licence would be contained in the tender.
"I hope that the tender will be made public -- at least the first stages -- within three months," said Infrastructure Ministry official Ronen Wolfman.

Israel has been trying to reach long-term agreements to import natural gas with Egypt, Qatar and Russia to diversify its energy sources and lower energy costs. Wolfman said he did not know when such a deal would be reached.
Last week officials from Russia's Gapzrom met with Infrastructure Ministry officials about supplying natural gas to the Jewish state.

In its statement the ministry said "the relevant government ministries would act to speed up the planning process of arranging sea and land routes and enable the setting up of gas (domestic) distribution infrastructure."

It added the companies involved in importing natural gas or were major consumers would be prohibited from participating in the tender. In addition, companies involved in petroleum refining in Israel would not be able to bid. The state-owned Electric Corp, however, will be allowed to distribute natural gas for it own use, the ministry said.
The ministry said the winner of the tender would have exclusivity for an undefined period.
"The companies will include in their bids how long they must have exclusivity. This will be one of the issues considered in the tender," Wolfman told Reuters.
